title: RelicTech: Troubleshooting
summary: Diagnose common RelicTech failures by shrinking the loop and testing one fix.

blocks.title: Common Failure
blocks.body: If a relic fails, read cooldown, charge, identity, and instability before trying again. Repeated failure usually means missing preparation, not random cruelty.

blocks.title: Reset The Loop
blocks.body: If a relic fails, read charge, cooldown, identity, and instability before trying again. Repeated failure usually means missing preparation.

blocks.title: One Fix At A Time
blocks.body: Change one variable, run a smaller test, and compare the result. Fixing three things at once can hide the part that actually mattered.

blocks.title: Retest Cleanly
blocks.body: Change one variable, test on a smaller route, and keep the fix only if the failure becomes easier to explain.
